newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said press releases from the Commission's weekly meeting, which takes place today in Rome, would be available from about 1830/1730 GMT at the Breydel building. He noted that the Commission would be shut for the Easter holidays on Thursday, Friday and Monday.
In response to questions, Vale de Almeida said he would check on the status of the Information Technology Agreement and whether the Commission was taking Korea to the WTO over liquor trade.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/250: The Commission clears a merger concerning Birmingham International Airport
- Central and Eastern Eurobarometer: Public Opinion and the European Union
